nexos.title: NexOS Agent-OS — Agent-Native Kernel Extensions for a RISC-V Teaching OS
nexos.description: Agent-native operating system extensions and a reproducible research pipeline.

contributions.kernel: Designed a kernel-level Agent abstraction with capability-based identity, per-process Context space, structured Tool Calls, and an event-driven Loop supporting heartbeat, IPC, file events, and priority + aging.
contributions.agentfs: Extended the filesystem with AgentFS semantic attributes, indexing, and batch metadata. A 10-block AB/BA experiment across 20 QEMU boots achieved a 3.98× reduction in metadata cost (74.9% faster, 0 failures).
contributions.reprolab: Built the four-role ReproLab reproducible research pipeline with SHA-256 evidence binding. The AgentOS path achieved a 16.2× speedup over application-level indexing; also implemented a virtio-serial LLM proxy.
contributions.award: Achieved Second Prize in the National College Computer System Development Capability Competition.

vit-retinamnist.title: ViT Compression for RetinaMNIST via Distillation-Guided Quantization
vit-retinamnist.description: Medical image classification with knowledge distillation and low-bit quantization.

contributions.classifier: Engineered a lightweight ViT-Small classifier for diabetic retinopathy grading on RetinaMNIST, combining knowledge distillation with GPTQ/AWQ low-bit quantization.
contributions.distillation: Distilled knowledge from a full-precision teacher into a quantized student, recovering accuracy under 4-bit compression and keeping F1 above the baseline.
contributions.competition: Achieved a top-tier ranking among participating teams in the 2nd China Algorithm Capability Competition National Final AI Track Model Lightweight Challenge.

cs229.title: CS229 Deep Learning Assignments — PyTorch (Python) and Burn (Rust)
cs229.description: Dual-framework implementation of deep learning models and exploration of neural network principles.

contributions.implementation: Implemented deep learning models in both PyTorch (Python) and Burn (Rust), demonstrating proficiency in both languages for deep learning tasks.
contributions.training: Gained hands-on experience in training and evaluating deep learning models and understanding the underlying principles of neural networks.
